items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Mel Powell and Red Norva have been working with before

ctx.x: He said, "No, he don't want you to sit there. He wants you to sit over there." I said, "I'm not gonna sit over there." "Well ..." "I'm not gonna -- we don't have but 5 pieces, I'm not gonna sit way over there away from the other four." He said, "Well, that's where he wants you to sit."

Now Benny used to get to the concert about an hour ahead of time, and he was always warming up in the dressing room, you know, warming up in the dressing room, so it pays to be ignorant sometimes, you know -- I don't know what kind of cat he is, you know, but Mel Powell and Red Norva have been working with before, and I said, "Well, where is he?" They said, "Well, he's in the dressing room warming up." And I said,

"Well, I'm going to see him." He said, "Oh, no -- you're not supposed to bother him when he's warming up." I said, again, "If he wants some drums tonight, he's gonna be disturbed" and you know, he said, "Well, I wouldn't do it!"
